claim: William Neil McCasland, 68, a retired Air Force major general, left his Albuquerque, New Mexico home on February 27, 2026 and has not been seen since. He commanded the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio and, earlier, the AFRL Phillips Research Site at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico, and held director-level posts at the Pentagon. Searchers recovered a light green shirt and hiking boots; his wallet, a .38 caliber revolver, a leather holster and a red backpack remain unaccounted for. Officials said at a March news conference that McCasland had reported "mental fog" before he disappeared and had cited it in stepping down from groups he worked with. The FBI joined the search within two weeks. Authorities have said there is no evidence linking the disappearance to research on unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP); after his retirement McCasland briefly worked with To The Stars, the company co-founded by musician Tom DeLonge that says it studies such reports.
